question: As of September 2024, who is serving as the Minister of Parliamentary Affairs in the Government of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kiren Rijiju**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kiren Rijiju** is serving as the **Minister of Parliamentary Affairs** in the Government of India as of **September 2024**.
 
• He is a prominent member of the ruling party, **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**.
 
• Prior to this role, he has served as the **Union Minister of Law and Justice** and held other significant portfolios in the Government.
 
• His contributions to the government include **initiating legal reforms** and enhancing parliamentary efficiency.
 
• Kiren Rijiju hails from **Arunachal Pradesh**, representing the northeastern region in national politics.
 
• His appointment as the Minister of Parliamentary Affairs emphasizes his extensive experience in managing legislative matters and ensuring smooth coordination between the government and the opposition.
 
• The Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs plays a crucial role in facilitating the **functioning of the Parliament** and maintaining decorum during sessions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **L Murugan**__

 __
 
• **L Murugan** is currently serving as the **Union Minister of State for Information and Broadcasting.**
 
• He belongs to **Tamil Nadu** and has a background in law and politics.
 
• His role primarily focuses on **media policies** and disseminating government information.
 
 
 
• **Tenzin Gyaltsen**__
 __
 
• **Tenzin Gyaltsen** is not a known political figure in the Government of India.
 
• This name could be fictional or refer to an individual in a different capacity outside Indian politics.
 
 
 
• **Arjun Ram**__
 
 
• **Arjun Ram Meghwal**, a prominent BJP leader, serves as the **Union Minister of Law and Justice** as of 2024.
 
• He has previously held portfolios such as **Minister of State for Parliamentary Affairs** and **Culture**.
 
• He is recognized for his efforts in legal reforms and promoting cultural heritage.
